as_told.title: Edgar Mitchell's conversion on return from the Moon

plain: The astronaut Edgar Mitchell, who flew to the Moon on Apollo 14 in 1971, is said to have had a kind of conversion experience on the trip home, one that changed how he saw everything. Michels brings this up on three episodes without naming a source: once he calls it his impression that it felt like a conversion, and once he calls it a telepathic, parapsychological experience that Mitchell has spoken about openly and that updated his whole worldview. If so, one of the few people to walk on the Moon came back convinced the mind reaches further than science allows.
